name: nomad2018-predict-transparent-conductors
description: Write a Python fit_predict(train, test_inputs, time_budget_s) function that learns from 2,700 (Al, Ga, In)2O3 materials given as DFT-relaxed structures and predicts formation energy per cation and band gap for 300 held-out materials, within a 300 s wall-clock budget on 4 CPU threads; scored by the mean of the two columns' RMSLE (lower is better).

sources.locator: NMD-18 (CC0): 3,000 sesquioxides with DFT-relaxed geometries, formation energy per atom and band gap
Sutton et al. 2019: competition dataset, Vegard's-law input geometries, relaxed-geometry comparison (Table 2)
grade.py (mean of the RMSLEs of formation_energy_ev_natom and bandgap_energy_ev)

notes: Kaggle dataset access and competition terms
